column9: Sir Edward's own site lists a distinct 'Smoky' variant in its range alongside Finest/Beer Reserve/Aged 12 Years. Not in this batch's samples (which are 'Finest', the base unpeated blend) but recorded so a future Smoky bottling does not inherit Finest's unpeated profile. Exact ppm/intensity not stated, kept at medium rather than heavy.

Evidenced directly by this batch's own product name ('Prologue Peated Small Batch No.2'), not an external source -- no citable URL found for the Prologue brand itself. Kept at medium (clearly peated but intensity unconfirmed) rather than heavy.
